title: Calendar Snapshotter
user: People who plan in calendars but need a recoverable, diffable local history when schedules shift or a calendar provider is unavailable.
smallest_useful_product: Local scheduled CalDAV/ICS snapshot utility that stores encrypted versioned ICS files, summarizes added/moved/cancelled events, and restores selected events to an export file.
success_measure: A pilot user can identify and restore a deliberately changed or deleted event from a snapshot in under two minutes.
constraints: Encrypt stored credentials and event data; handle recurrence/time zones correctly; use CalDAV/ICS standards; avoid sending any event content to a third party.
